title: Grinch-mas on the River
description: YOU DON'T WANT TO MISS THIS EVENT❤️💚 There is going to be so many things to do at this Grinch themed event! (personally I am beyond excited for this one) There will be Grinch themed goodies, drinks, and handmade gifts. They will be playing the Grinch Movie under the bridge, as well as competitions with... CASH PRIZES! So many different contests and wonderful vendors to get you in the holiday spirit!
